responsibility: This generator emits both predicate and constraint support derived from machine-description DEFINE_PREDICATE and DEFINE_*CONSTRAINT forms. It validates predicate RTL expressions, lowers embedded C blocks into helper subfunctions, and can generate tm-preds.h declarations, tm-constrs.h constraint enums and classification helpers, or insn-preds.cc implementations of new-style predicates and constraint query routines, making it the central source of generated operand-predicate and machine-constraint APIs.
